name: Floating Contact Button for MAX and Telegram
author: Alexander Alekseenko

sections.description:
Floating contact button for Telegram and MAX Messenger.

⚠️ Disclaimer: This plugin is an independent project developed by cryptolamer.ru and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to MAX Messenger, Telegram Messenger, or their respective owners.

✅ Features:
– Floating buttons for MAX Messenger and Telegram Messenger
– Lightweight and privacy-friendly (no tracking, no external servers)
– Easy to configure in WordPress admin

PRO version (coming soon): add WhatsApp, Email and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/floating-contact-button-for-max-and-telegram directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Floating Contact Button for MAX and Telegram to configure.
sections.faq:
Is this free?

Yes. Telegram Messenger and MAX Messenger integrations are free forever.

Is this official?

No. This is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with MAX Messenger or Telegram Messenger.

Can I add other messengers?

Yes. The PRO version (coming soon) will support WhatsApp, Email, and additional messengers.
